deviations.rule: 11 (Output: one row per distinct firm_id, year; repeats collapsed)
deviations.what: firm_year is converted to the output skeleton without unique(), so repeated (firm_id, year) rows in firm_year produce repeated output rows instead of being collapsed to one.

notes: Dating (filing_year), first-listed filter, missing-class exclusion, base window t-5..t-1, forward window t+1..t+3, exclusion of year t, anti-join count, empty-base NA, no-forward 0, firm separation and column order all match the spec; the only problem is the missing de-duplication of firm_year. Treating an empty-string cpc_subclass as missing is a reasonable reading, not a deviation.
